scope: Paired finite-horizon objective replay; not PPO retraining or hardware qualification.
interpretation: Same deterministic actions and physical rollouts as saved native evaluations, replayed with the actual terminal training reward wrapper at full scheduled fraction. Finite-horizon native and shaped returns, both undiscounted and discounted. No learned-value bootstrap, GAE, exploration or training update is included; this does not by itself identify PPO optimization failure or infinite-horizon preference. Preserve validation cases but separate them from training cases.
step_budget_rate_interpretation: Undiscounted diagnostic average over deterministic train cases under the declared stage/primitive control-step budgets and within-bucket case cycles. This is not the stochastic discounted/bootstrapped PPO objective.
training_terminal_interpretation: Counts only completed episodes appearing in rollout records with full contract_fraction_mean1 after36864transitions. Noise, changing actor and chosen training cases differ from deterministic full evaluation; no direct matched-policy attribution.
conclusion: All67 arm cases losing full success have lower final discounted shaped return. The deterministic step-budget average also worsens. This does not support assuming that these regressions earn better reward; audit optimization/exploration/value estimation next. No infinite-horizon or causal optimizer conclusion.
